text: Among finished runs at the production compute 6*N*D = 1.08e+21 FLOPs (D = C/(6N), same schedule for all), which model size gives the lowest final loss?  Options: A: N=8.9e+08, B: N=1.8e+09, C: N=3.6e+09, D: N=7.1e+09
Final validation loss (nats/token) of the production model N=3e9 trained on D=6e10 tokens with the WSD schedule, run to completion.

The production cosine run (N=3e9, D=6e10) is evaluated at its checkpoint after 40% of its tokens.  By how much (nats/token) is that checkpoint's loss higher than the final loss of a separate WSD run of the same model trained to completion on 0.4*6e10 = 2.4e10 tokens?

If the production cosine run is stopped early (f_stop as documented), by how much (nats/token) will its loss at the stop exceed the final loss it would have reached had it completed?  Give the set over the documented range of f_stop.
The production cosine run's checkpoint after 80% of its tokens has a lower loss than a finished WSD run of the same model trained to completion on 60% of the production tokens.
